description: Inspect a public GitHub repository, pull request ratchet delta (pr), head-to-head rival shootout (vs), file path (focus), or organization rollup (org) via read-only static Tree-sitter AST analysis (<= 100MB source archive). Example: repo='go-chi/chi' (or repo='go-chi/chi', pr=42, or org='go-chi') returns the AST scorecard and Day-0 baseline preview. Use when auditing a public GitHub repo, PR, comparison, or org URL. Do NOT use when checking private repositories (private codebases require local CLI inspection via @mgantlett/nomos).

focus.description: Optional file or directory path within the repository to spotlight.

org.description: Optional GitHub organization or user handle when requesting an org-level rollup.

pr.description: Optional pull request number for a base-vs-head AST ratchet delta.

repo.description: Public GitHub owner/repo slug or full https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> URL.

vs.description: Optional second public owner/repo slug for a side-by-side structural shootout.

name: xray_github_repo

canonicalUrl.description: Canonical documentation or twin URL for citation.

hangoverScore.description: Composite 0-100 AI Hangover structural debt score.

title: Inspect Public GitHub Repo, PR Delta, Shootout, or Org AST X-Ray
